category: Transformer FFN / MLP block (2 matmuls + activation, composition)
edge_cases: two matmuls on HMX with a ReLU+requant activation between: H=ReLU((sx12((X.W1*17+8)>>4)+b1)>>8) [0..127], out=sat_i8((sx12((H.W2*17+8)>>4)+b2)>>3)
matmul1 X[64x128].W1[128x128] -> H[64x128]; matmul2 H[64x128].W2[128x128] -> out[64x128]; both are 2x4 grids of 32x32 output tiles, each accumulating over 4 K-tiles

intermediate activation H staged VTCM-resident between the two matmuls (bulk 128B vector copy in, bulk copy back out for matmul2 activation packing) alongside the HMX crouton operand slots -- hmx+hvx+vtcm = 3 mechanism groups
HMX accumulator persists across K-tiles (one mxclracc per output tile); activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot, weight 4-deep packed, different load limits in one packet
input ranges keep |r1|<=1224 and |r2|<=1904 (both < 2048) so both HMX 12-bit requant fields are exact (no HMX saturation) and the block is bit-exact
ReLU sparsity: b1[0]=-4000 (column always ReLU-killed to 0), b1[1]=+4000 (column always fires)
crouton pack/unpack staged through cacheable buffers, moved to/from VTCM in bulk 128B vector copies (scalar VTCM access ~48 cyc would lose)
harness reference computed via two HVX vrmpy matmuls, cross-checked against an INDEPENDENT full scalar FFN golden on row 0 (both matmuls)
S,D,Dff are 32-multiples (crouton requirement); D=Dff=128 so each vrmpy reduction is one whole vector (no tail); discrimination via nearmiss + edge bias values
transposed-W2 near-miss (still HMX+VTCM+HVX, correct ReLU) must fail
name: i8_ffn_block
